title: Introduce invocation spectral breakdown and deferred KV hydrator for low-overhead token observability
author: Jorge Morales
description: Motivation: long-tail token latencies and micro-patterns inside model invocations are a leading signal for both perf regressions and cost drift, but the current token telemetry is either too heavy (full KV snapshot per invocation) or too coarse (endpoint-level aggregates). This PR introduces two complementary pieces: 1) an invocation spectral breakdown that classifies token emission latency into compact frequency bands (burst, steady, tail) and exposes a small set of numeric fingerprints per invocation; 2) a deferred KV hydrator that records lightweight cache-miss + hit markers inline and only hydrates full KV metadata asynchronously for sampled traces to keep telemetry CPU and network cost low. What this delivers: - Per-invocation spectral fingerprint: a 3-value vector (burst/steady/tail percentiles) plus a dominant-shape tag that lets dashboards cluster invocations with similar emission patterns. - Compact cost anchors: token-cost attribution tied to spectral bands so we can see whether tail tokens or early bursts drive cost. - Deferred KV hydrator: reduces per-request telemetry payload by ~4x in internal load tests while still allowing full context on sampled traces. Implementation notes: - New lightweight proto for spectral fingerprint attached to invocation spans (spectral.band_burst, spectral.band_steady, spectral.band_tail, spectral.shape_hint). - Telemetry path: runtime emits the fingerprint synchronously; hydrator enqueues KV fetch jobs to an internal async queue and updates trace logs when available. - Dashboard: new panels in Observability -> Invocations: spectral scatter, band heatmap, and cost-anchor stacked bars. - Alerts: new alertrule invocation-spectral-regression that watches dominant-shape drift and a low-noise alert for tail-percentile increase using an EWMA smoothing. Rollout plan: - Feature gated behind telemetry.feature.spectral and default-off for <beta> orgs. - Canary: enable for 5% of traffic for 48 hours, then 25% for 72 hours, then global. - Monitoring: dashboards include a canary health panel and hydrator queue lag. - Rollback: revert the feature flag; hydrator is async so turning off feature immediately stops extra queueing. Backwards compatibility: spectral footprint is additive to span tags and does not change existing trace shapes. Privacy: the hydrator avoids returning raw prompt content in async fetches and respects redaction policy. Checklist: - [x] Runtime: compute fingerprint and emit span tags - [x] Telemetry: add compact proto and ingestion path - [x] Deferred KV hydrator service with rate limit and backpressure - [x] Console: dashboard panels and example queries - [x] Alerts: new rules and test alerts - [x] Tests: unit tests for fingerprinting; integration test for hydrator queueing - [x] Docs: observability guide snippet and rollout steps Usage notes: sample query strings and example dashboard links are in the Files Changed section. Known limitations: very short invocations (<8 tokens) have noisy band composition and are excluded from banded metrics by the runtime. Future work: add model-architecture-aware band thresholds and automatically synthesize fingerprint baselines per-model.

review_comments: Aisha Patel: Nice work overall — can you quantify expected telemetry bandwidth reduction in the PR description? The hydrator queue needs rate-limiting knobs (suggested: per-tenant QPS and global throttle).
Jorge Morales: Added numbers to the description (approx 4x payload reduction in internal load tests) and implemented per-tenant qps and a global token bucket in hydrator/service.go. PTAL.
Samir Desai: The EWMA smoothing window in alerts looks tight for high-variance tenants; suggest 15m by default and make it configurable per-tenant.
Jorge Morales: Switched alert default to 15m EWMA and added a tenant override via console. Also added test fixture for a high-variance synthetic tenant.
Elena Kovalenko: Small nit: spectral.proto should include a version field for future schema migration. Also please add a migration note in telemetry/ingest/README.md.
Jorge Morales: Added schema_version to spectral.proto and a short migration note. Thanks for catching that.
release_notes: Add invocation spectral fingerprints and deferred KV hydrator to reduce telemetry overhead and provide banded token cost/latency breakdowns. New dashboard panels and an alert rule for spectral drift included. Feature gated; rollout controlled via telemetry.feature.spectral.
